hadith:
To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq) - Narrated Anas bin Malik:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "While I was walking in Paradise (on the night of Mi'raj), I saw a river, on the two banks of which there were tents made of hollow pearls. I asked, "What is this, O Gabriel?' He said, 'That is the Kauthar which Your Lord has given to you.' Behold! Its scent or its mud was sharp smelling musk!" (The sub-narrator, Hudba is in doubt as to the correct expression. )
message: When hearts are sealed against truth, it is only through sincere seeking and turning to Allah—Al Muhiy, the Giver of Life—that we can find awakening and guidance on the Straight Path. Let us open our hearts to receive Allah's message, seek His forgiveness, and remember that He alone gives life to our souls through submission and remembrance, just as He has prepared eternal blessings for those who truly believe.
name:
Al Muhiy - الْمُحْيِي - The Giver of life

The name Al Muhiy originates from the Arabic root 'حيا' (ḥ-y-y), which is associated with life and living. This name emphasizes the belief that Allah is the source of all life and has the ability to give it and restore it. It reflects His mercy and control over the cycles of life and death.
verse:
Fussilat - Explained in Detail - 41:5-7

They say, “Our hearts are veiled against what you are calling us to, there is deafness in our ears, and there is a barrier between us and you. So do ˹whatever you want˺ and so shall we!”

Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a man like you, ˹but˺ it has been revealed to me that your God is only One God. So take the Straight Way towards Him, and seek His forgiveness. And woe to the polytheists—

those who do not pay alms-tax and are in denial of the Hereafter.
